request: a simple block-building sandbox game with a 32x32 block world
thesis: A tiny voxel-ish sandbox where one click places or removes a block and the whole 32x32 world is visible, tactile and persistent: the joy is instant, reversible building.
job: open the page and see a 32x32 world at once
pick a block type from a palette
place a block on a cell
remove a block from a cell
see which cell is hovered and what is selected
undo a mistake / clear the world

principles: no fail state in a sandbox
tricks: seed a small starter build so the world is not empty
tests: can a stranger place a block in 3 seconds
does every click change visible state

principles: pointer events cover mouse and touch
blocks read as blocks: bevel, top highlight, bottom shade
limited palette of earthy and bright materials
tricks: draw to canvas with per-cell bevel

principles: state is a 32x32 array, render from state
canvas for the grid, DOM for the palette

kinds.name: top-down grid builder
kinds.what: square canvas of 32x32 cells viewed from above, each cell holds one block type

kinds.name: isometric block world
kinds.what: cells drawn as 3D cubes with height stacking

kinds.name: side-view terraria-like
kinds.what: 32 wide by 32 tall slice, gravity-free building

descriptions: each material has base colour plus lighter top-left edge and darker bottom-right edge
eraser is a palette entry too, so touch users can remove
behaviors: click on same type is a no-op

tokens.cell px: 16 to 20 on desktop, scales to fit width

descriptions: status shows hovered x,y and selected block
counter shows placed blocks of 1024 cells

anti_keywords.not: inventory, crafting, health, enemies, procedural terrain
anti_keywords.instead: simple means only place, remove, pick a block; leave the rest out
everything drawn with canvas and inline CSS/JS
bevelled materials with a subtle texture-like shade

anti_keywords.not: an empty grey world with no cue
anti_keywords.instead: small seeded starter build plus a one-line hint
visible eraser, undo, clear, hotkey hints

checks: grid is exactly 32 columns by 32 rows
click places the selected block and the counter rises
right-click / eraser removes it and the counter falls
usable at phone width and no console errors
